## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · seat `domain:ui#1` · 2026-10-27T08:58Z · #26521

Head `0c64d31a` (read from the PR object). Fixes #26521; Part of #26444 (devx seat 2's parent).

- **Shape.** 17 files, +220 / −98. Tests, scripts and docs only, so it carries the `skip-changeset` label and no changeset. New module `ui/scripts/__tests__/helpers/ui-package-population.mjs`: the one place the ui population floors are written. Every site reads it, including both gates' `MIN_PACKAGES`.
- **Floors (measured on `main` `6a7c0fe3`, after app-shell went private), each about ⅔ of the measurement.**

  | Population | Measured | Floor |
  |---|---|---|
  | Published | 36 | 24 |
  | Workspace members | 43 | 28 |
  | `sideEffects: false` | 11 | 7 |
  | `sideEffects` arrays | 17 | 11 |
  | tsc-built | 11 | 7 |
  | Catalog entries | 432 | 288 |

  The catalog-entry floor is written once, in `ui/examples/schema-catalog/test/catalog-entry-floor.ts`, replacing 8 call sites (the 4 the card listed and 4 more above 400). The `QUICK_REFERENCE.md` prose count is deleted, and its test now refuses one.
- **Not weakened.** On an emptied population, all 31 floor assertions go red. Deleting one ui package or one catalog entry reds none.
- **Seat rulings on the open questions.**
  - One module with per-population floors: yes.
  - Placement under `__tests__/helpers/`: kept. The two gate scripts import it at run time under plain `node`, and the docblock says why. A new top-level `ui/scripts/*.mjs` would join the gate-script population, so it would be a new script for the script census rather than a helper.
- **Surface deviations (in the report).** `check-node-esm-load.test.ts` was forced, because it pinned `MIN_PACKAGES >= 30`. `component-fixture-declared-keys.test.ts` had a per-type census at exactly the measured value; it moved to ⅔ in place, the same class of fix.
- **Governed surface.** `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 26576`: not governed.
- **Checks pinned to the head.** All check runs completed: 0 failing, 0 pending. The seat's landing script checked this before posting.
- **Evidence (dev).** ui `scripts/`: 178 files green. Gates: 20/20.
- **Serial constraints.** #26365 (plugin-ai retirement, held) also edits these floors and `QUICK_REFERENCE.md`. If this PR lands first, #26365 merges `main` and reads the constant.

Landing: ready + auto-merge through the relay. devx seat 2 is told on merge.
